annotations.text: League builder — three directions, one engine. Everywhere the same settled model: drop a Pokémon once and its evolution line fills the column, driven by the league level curve (12 / 16 / 21 / 26 / 31 / 36 / 41 / 46 / 54 / 62). Sample card: Marina, Water specialist. Pick a direction and I build it into the real /pokemon-league-builder page next.

A — Card Table. Faithful to the /vp/ template: the full 10-row × 6-line grid, always on screen.
+ Instant whole-card read; densest.
− Sprites repeat a lot; cells stay small; least room per Pokémon.

B — Evolution Lanes (leading candidate). Each line is a lane; a form spans the stages it covers; the span boundary IS the future drag handle.
+ Shows the auto-fill model directly; calm; no repeated sprites.
− Reading one stage's exact team takes a horizontal scan.

C — Stage Focus. Pick a stage, see that team large; the rail keeps the whole progression in miniature.
+ Best per-Pokémon detail; doubles as the mobile shape.
− The full card is never visible at full size — softest reading of the fits-on-screen goal.

Below: the league overview (gym N derives its team from the N−1 badges row; Elite 4 members share the Elite 4 row, the champion shows Full team, the boss picks a stage) and the mobile shape, which reuses Direction C whatever wins on desktop.
